integrity.finite_verification: Exact finite checks are supplementary and not a proof of the asymptotic result.
integrity.proof_scope: Direct occupancy concentration, Poisson approximation and moderate deviation for strict turnover; cited winner-containment theorem imported as stated.

scientific_limitations: Exactly quadratic reinforcement; only simultaneous multinomial resampling with n candidates initialized at one vote each.
The strict second-round turnover is proved here; the eventual-winner corollary separately assumes a published second-round containment conclusion.
Asymptotic n→infinity; no effective onset guarantee, uniform exponent neighborhood, or higher-critical-exponent claim.
title: Critical leader turnover in quadratic reinforced voting
